title: Towards Recommender Systems LLMs Playground (RecSysLLMsP): Exploring Polarization and Engagement in Simulated Social Networks

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating social network interactions using LLM-based agents with assigned political attitudes (ranging from extremely liberal to extremely conservative) and measuring their engagement and polarization (via negative reactions like 'Angry' and 'Sad' and self-reported attitude shifts) when exposed to politically charged content across different recommender system setups (Similarity, Balanced, and Plurality).
